description: Win-back list: customers with no visit in `months` (default 18; imported visits count), leaving out anyone with an open job or a visit coming up. Filter by job type words, a tag, or whether they have a maintenance plan. Each row has the last visit day, the last job, lifetime paid and whether they can be emailed or texted. Also counts who can't be contacted and shows the email they would get. Owner or office. Read only; customers.winBackQueue sends.

title.description: What the email says is due. Default tune-up.

name: customers_winBack

lifetime_paid_minor.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (cents).

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
